Hemispheres centered with poles about a third of the way from the bottom for the southern hemisphere, and a third of the way from the top for the northern hemisphere.
Includes illustrations, including the sun and moon and advertisements.
Publication statement: [London] : Sold by G. Willdey at the great-toy shop next to the dog tavern in Ludgate Street where may be had several other maps of this size, 1714.

Relief shown pictorially. Hemispheres centered with poles about a third of the way from the bottom for the southern hemisphere, and a third of the way from the top for the northern hemisphere. Includes illustrations, including the sun and moon and advertisements. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
dct_title_s: A new and correct map of the world projected upon the plane of the horizon laid down from the newest discoveries and most exact observations
